added.declaredIntent: The daily board, one page at a time. Score, then accuracy, then EV lost, then submission time — the specification's order. Accuracy and EV lost come from the attempt's own graded decisions, never from the week bucket.

Ends one player's room membership, migrating the host role and closing the room when it empties. Server-only: the argument names whose seat to release. leave_room is the caller-scoped wrapper, and the Edge Functions call this when a player cashes out of a table that has already dealt.
Closes a lobby room that has no members and no game. Server-only: the argument names somebody else's room.

Publishes the seed of every challenge whose window has closed, so the commitment published before play can actually be checked. Idempotent. Server-only: the guard trigger refuses an early reveal independently.
Stamps the caller's own last_seen_at. The fallback beneath ephemeral Realtime presence: called when a player publishes presence, so "last seen" means "last on the presence channel".

detail.using_expr:
(EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM game_session_seats s
  WHERE ((s.user_id = auth.uid()) AND (s.status <> 'left'::seat_status) AND (realtime.topic() = ('game:'::text || (s.game_session_id)::text)))))

added.declaredIntent: A game broadcast is readable only by an account holding a seat at that game that it has not left.
A client may publish presence and nothing else. Game state is broadcast by the server alone.
The shared presence roster requires a signed-in account; the client filters it to friends.
